rationale: CR-001 resolved: bytes_content() now cached before try block (line 71), used in both conversion (line 73) and logging (line 81), and markdown fallback assigned as first statement in except block (line 75) before logger.warning. The fix eliminates the double-call hazard and ensures the fallback is always assigned before use.

finding_status.evidence: Line 71 caches bytes_content() result in raw_bytes before try block. Line 73 passes raw_bytes to convert_file_to_markdown(). Line 75 assigns markdown = f"[Conversion failed...]" as first statement in except block, before logger.warning at line 76. Line 81 uses cached raw_bytes in len() call. The double-call and late-assignment defects are both fixed.
